name: Ultra-Thin Webcam Cover Slide (6 pack)
caption:
Is your laptop camera covered right now? 👀

This ultra-thin webcam cover sticks above the camera. Slide it open for video calls, and slide it shut when you are done. It is only 0.022 inch thick.

The pack has six, so the laptop, tablet and the kids' computers are all covered, for about the price of a snack. Rated about 4.2 stars from more than 12,000 ratings.

Tip: on laptops that close very tight, like some MacBooks, check the fit guide on the listing first.
